title: Apply and verify corporate Windows profile
description: From projects/nixos-config.md lines 43 and 16-60. Apply hosts/windows/work-laptop through the approved company path; stop if endpoint policy blocks a step. Preserve the Microsoft-first and no-unapproved-third-party-tools boundary.

title: Complete NixOS-WSL CUDA integration
description: From projects/nixos-config.md lines 62-72. Wire config.wsl.wslLib into programs.nix-ld.libraries, avoid global LD_LIBRARY_PATH, and verify porygon and delcatty host CUDA separately from optional GPU containers and scoped WSLg acceleration.

title: Verify Browser comment floating rule
description: From projects/nixos-config.md line 84. When the ChatGPT Browser comment sidecar next opens, verify the managed Paneru rule floats it; keep the documented recovery chords available.

title: Revisit declarative Hister policy in Helium
description: From projects/nixos-config.md line 96. Keep the Web Store installation mutable until upstream Helium extension-policy issues imputnet/helium#1737 and #2259 are fixed, then re-evaluate declarative enforcement.

title: Revisit Herdr Plannotator integration
description: From projects/nixos-config.md line 111. Wait for backnotprop/plannotator#1147 to ship and plannotator/herdr-plannotator#1 to merge, preferably at a tagged revision; package fixed hashes and avoid upstream installers.

title: Evaluate replacement DNS ad blocking
description: From projects/nixos-config.md line 242. Inventory protections lost from eero and compare a narrowly tested Cloudflare Gateway policy with Unbound RPZ or a pinned blocklist, including provenance, privacy, false positives, bypass resistance, and rollback. Do not add AdGuard by default.

title: Re-review Miniflux LAN HTTPS route
description: From projects/nixos-config.md lines 290-295 and 318. Wait for a stable release containing pending security fixes; preserve loopback and Cloudflare Access until an isolated cutover passes a fresh advisory review.

title: Revisit Paperless LAN HTTPS route
description: From projects/nixos-config.md lines 310-311 and 318. Require human-account TOTP, known API-token inventory, and supported upstream secure session/CSRF cookie controls. Do not maintain a downstream cookie patch.

title: Complete Flygon physical acceptance
description: From projects/nixos-config.md line 1122. Verify audio, camera, Bluetooth pairing, touchpad gestures, brightness keys, Caps/Escape/Control behavior, fingerprint authentication, lock/unlock, dock monitors, expansion-card hotplug, suspend/resume, then hibernate/resume with no unsaved work.

title: Register Baymax private WARP hostname
description: From projects/nixos-config.md line 181. Register baymax.warp.midsorbet.me, verify the FQDN from iPhone, and use the short baymax search-suffix form only on a supported desktop client. Existing Apple Reminder: x-apple-reminder://0CD37003-ABF5-4A98-9779-D78B9F851AF4.
